name: Morristown Beard Day Camp
description_short: Day camp run by Morristown Beard School for ages 4 to 14, with sports, arts and crafts, drama, swimming and science on a daily schedule. Campers 6 to 14 are grouped by age and gender; 4 and 5 year olds are coed groups.
notes: Camp day is 8:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., with before care and after care available. Registration for summer 2027 opens in December 2026. Rates are not posted yet; the camp's registration site (summer.mbs.net) could not be reached.
